publication_boundary: Only sanitized source identities, attribution, learned model parameters, derived learned features, role identifiers/labels and outcome records are published. Raw image/count observation records, acquisition HTML and incidental contact metadata are not redistributed.
framework_license: MIT applies to framework code; it does not replace the source dataset license.

datasets.id: UCI Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits
datasets.citation: Alpaydin, E. and Kaynak, C. (1998), Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits, UCI Machine Learning Repository, DOI:10.24432/C50P49
datasets.preserved_license_note: Standard CC BY 4.0 legal text is shared with the trained-support notice. UCI license designation is independently recorded below; the PolyAI dataset is not the source of the optical-digits observations.
datasets.uses: From-scratch encoder/head training on grouped roles from official train; official distinct-writer test opened only after the global seal. Counts are divided by the declared scale 16. Digit-8 diversion to manual review is a project-derived policy, not a UCI label.
datasets.semantic_adapter: 64 row-major 8x8 block counts scaled by 16; independently trained 32-unit affine/ReLU feature extractor; 10 original class codes plus a reserved manual-review output.
